summary: Same-agent review checked pinned scalar, temporal, number-format and cache contracts against the actual Calc and Worker entry points.
findings: The represented Calc model retains its numeric scalar owner and formatter, including the ODS date-format exception for formulas and numeric nonbinary logical values.
evidence_refs: 138 Calc assertions, 14 shared conversion assertions, external-ref-cache.ods and tdf126116 short-date assertions
residual_risks: The tdf126116 assertion port uses an explicit cell style because row and column default styles remain separate work. Alternate numeric attribute namespaces and full UNO currency properties remain partial.
